note: Per-university negative findings observed during the 8x20 build-out. These are DURABLE records of what each site cost us -- read by `crawler validate`, never recomputed. A finding is retired only by fixing it, not by a later run happening to look fine.

findings.finding: fragmented faculty subsites — no single program index; three seeds needed (FMI, PHLS, chemistry) and each faculty is a separate host/path shape
findings.impact: onboarding survey works, but seeds are hand-found per faculty

findings.finding: language of instruction is NOT stated on any SU program page (0/20 probed 2026-08-22). Earlier versions of this finding said the opposite in both directions; the probe settles it. The frozen key's «Български» entries were labeller inferences, since amended to null
findings.impact: 18 language nulls are HONEST, not recoverable; matrix bucket corrected

findings.finding: fee source still states the 2025/2026 cycle; the year-lag check fires on every run (20 values)
findings.impact: publish blocks every time; promoted only by standing human clear

findings.finding: many programs share one faculty page, so per-program field resolution is weak
findings.impact: 36/100 fields extract

findings.finding: every program lives on one admissions page; the onboarding link survey has nothing to propose (0 proposals, $0.35 spent to learn it)
findings.impact: programs enumerated by hand from page text

findings.finding: shared admissions page yields few per-program values
findings.impact: 24/90 fields extract

findings.finding: site redirects browser-like user agents to a /region-selector/ interstitial; our fetcher sends a real browser UA by design, so link discovery saw 1 link on a 99-link page. Region choices are JS-rendered, so no cookie can be lifted
findings.impact: discovery only possible via sitemap.xml

findings.finding: 17 bachelor majors + 1 EMBA is the whole degree catalogue; the rest of /bachelor-degrees/ are minors and short courses
findings.impact: 18 programs, not 20 — padding would ship non-degrees as Programs

findings.finding: sitemap carries no program pages; all programs named on one shared specialties page
findings.impact: enumerated by hand; 15 programs is all the page lists

findings.finding: shared specialties page carries little per-program data
findings.impact: 26/75 fields extract

findings.finding: three programs have no row in the fee order (Медицинска рехабилитация, Медико-социални дейности, Обществено здраве и здравен мениджмънт)
findings.impact: tuition ships as an honest null for those three

findings.finding: site is a catch-all — /, /specialnosti/ and /kandidatstudentski-kampanii/ return byte-identical HTML; the 4,819-URL sitemap holds news and projects but no program pages
findings.impact: programs found only via per-faculty specialnosti pages linking per-program PDFs

findings.finding: a 460k-char candidate handbook names every program and was REJECTED as a shared page: all 20 programs would extract the same first-match values, verbatim-present and therefore invisible to the provenance gate
findings.impact: would have manufactured 20 confidently wrong programs; per-program PDFs used instead

findings.finding: MEASURED (5-program graded sample): duration and admission are visible to a human browser but unreachable by the fetch route — 9 of 25 cells. language and tuition are NOT on the programme pages at all: the labeller confirmed them absent, so those nulls are honest, not losses
findings.impact: JS gap costs 36% of graded cells (9/25); 44% (11/25) of nulls are genuinely-absent data. Every shipped degree graded correct (5/5)

findings.finding: on-site program index is JS-loaded and the 74 gzipped sub-sitemaps carry no programmes; only the separate e-catalog serves static per-programme pages
findings.impact: discovery via ecatalog.nbu.bg only

findings.finding: Docling merged a fee row's cells: «освободени 310 EUR» came out as ONE cell and the row lost columns, so the join read «освободени» where the labeller read 310 EUR (su-cult)
findings.impact: 1 graded wrong; a merged cell can silently flip a fee between exempt and charged

findings.finding: MEASURED: the 15 programs added in the build-out have no fee or admission joins wired, so duration/tuition/admission ship null. shu-122 (Икономика) ships NOTHING at all — even degree — while every other program manages it
findings.impact: 12 of 25 graded cells are MISS; all are unwired config, not extraction errors

findings.finding: refusing the 460k-char handbook as a shared source cost NO tuition coverage: the labeller found every fee in the properly-structured fee orders, which per-program joins can reach safely
findings.impact: the safe choice was also the complete one — recorded so it is not revisited

findings.finding: PROVEN wrong-row contamination on a shared page: muv-medicina and muv-rentgenov-laborant shipped the IDENTICAL «ОКС „бакалавър"» snippet, taken from a sentence about a different program (Организация и управление на военни формирования). Medicine is магистър. Both values are verbatim in the artifact, so the provenance gate passed them | FIXED 2026-08-22: tier-G harvest is region-scoped via program_region() (word-bounded name anchors, REGION_WINDOW); regrade confirms both programs now ship in-region values
findings.impact: 2 graded wrong. The gate proves presence, not attribution — on a shared page the first match wins regardless of which program is being resolved. UniRuse and ANIS are also shared-page and NOT yet graded

findings.finding: first FABRICATION in the benchmark: Патофизиология degree came from an EU-project announcement about dissertation defence — an anchor pointing at an unrelated page
findings.impact: 1 fabrication in 215 graded cells; a bad anchor can assert what no source states

findings.finding: fee join reads a single figure where the source states a per-year progression (Кинезитерапия: shipped «500 евро», source says 500 € first year then 410 €)
findings.impact: 1 graded wrong; understates multi-year fees

findings.finding: shared-page contamination CONFIRMED at a second university: uniruse-se and uniruse-cs shipped the identical «ОКС „магистър"» from their shared faculty page, though both were added from UniRuse's BACHELOR index. The single-page control program (Право) showed no contamination — isolating the shared page as the cause | FIXED 2026-08-22: same mechanism; regrade confirms both fabrications became honest nulls (OK_NULL vs the frozen key)
findings.impact: 2 fabrications. With MUVarna this is 4 defects across 2 of the 3 shared-page universities; ANIS is the third and is still ungraded

findings.finding: shared-page contamination did NOT occur here, refuting the hypothesis that shared pages are inherently unsafe. ANIS's page-wide statements genuinely apply to every program (single-faculty academy), so identical values are correct. The real risk is a shared page carrying PROGRAM-SPECIFIC claims (MUVarna, UniRuse), not shared pages as such
findings.impact: sharpens the defect: the resolver must distinguish claim SCOPE, not avoid shared sources

findings.finding: where a page states two competing values, the cascade takes the first: shipped «2 или 3 семестъра» and «само по документи» where the labeller ruled «4 семестъра» and the ЗВО minimum-grade rule govern
findings.impact: 4 graded wrong — first-match selection, not attribution error

findings.finding: attribution fix EXPOSED a correct-by-accident value: akusherka's old «ОКС „бакалавър"» was lifted from the wrong sentence yet happened to be right; the in-region candidate is a pharmacy-management continuation sentence near an «Акушерка» mention — wrong. Candidate selection (finding 2), not attribution
findings.impact: 1 graded wrong that used to look correct; right answers from wrong rows are still defects

findings.finding: continuation sentences («могат да продължат образованието си в ОКС „магистър"») shipped as the program's own degree — live on the faculty pages. FIXED 2026-08-22 with a lookbehind guard on bg-oks-inline; socped now ships its correct bachelor statement
findings.impact: was an ungraded wrong entering promoted data; now correct

findings.finding: REGION_WINDOW cannot bound at UNCONFIGURED sections: muv-inspektor's span crosses into the unconfigured «Оптометрист» block within 2,500 chars and ships its «ОКС „Магистър"». Deterministically unsolvable without page section structure
findings.impact: 1 known ungraded wrong; the full fix is section-aware candidate selection (finding 2)

findings.finding: FIXED 2026-08-22: the ЗВО admission rule and 4-semester duration — page-wide claims the labeller ruled applicable during grading — promoted into config anchors on all 18 programs (the ADR-0003 escape hatch). Regrade 24/25, 0 wrong (was 14/25 with 4 wrong)
findings.impact: +30 shipped cells, all grading correct
